exposure: Caesarean section following failed instrumental delivery
cohort: 119 women who had a caesarean section following a failed instrumental delivery out of 26,856 births at a large London Teaching Hospital over a 5-year period
finding: Emergency caesarean section during the second stage of labour is associated with maternal and fetal complications.
mod_finding: A 'failed instrumental delivery score' (FIDS) may aid practitioners in predicting an increased likelihood of a failed operative vaginal birth and therefore to consider a trial of operative vaginal delivery in the theatre.
